content.name: Gurpreet Sandhu
content.title: Director of Operations
content.summary: Operations leader with 17 years in food processing, cold-chain warehousing and port logistics. Directs 420 staff across three Lower Mainland terminals with a $58 million operating budget, and led the automation program that raised container throughput by 22% without adding yard space.

experience.title: Director of Operations
bullets: Direct operations at three container and transload terminals with 420 unionized and salaried staff and a $58 million budget.
Led a $14 million yard automation and appointment-booking program that lifted throughput by 22% on the same footprint.
Negotiated two collective agreements alongside HR with no lost workdays.
Brought lost-time injury frequency down by 38% over three years through a joint health and safety committee action plan.
Report monthly to the executive team and the board on volume, cost per TEU and safety.

experience.title: Operations Manager
bullets: Managed two cold-storage warehouses holding 38,000 pallet positions for seafood and berry exporters.
Redesigned dock scheduling with exporters, cutting average truck turn time from 95 to 55 minutes.
Oversaw a refrigeration upgrade that reduced electricity use by 17%, with a BC Hydro incentive covering part of the cost.
Kept CFIA and customer audits free of major non-conformances for five consecutive years.

experience.title: Production Manager
bullets: Ran a frozen fruit processing plant with 150 seasonal and full-time workers.
Introduced overall equipment effectiveness tracking on four lines and raised OEE from 61% to 74%.
Built a seasonal hiring and training plan that staffed peak berry season with fewer first-week injuries.

experience.title: Production Supervisor
bullets: Supervised packaging lines and 40 operators on afternoon shift.
Led the plant's first HACCP refresher program for frontline staff.
Cut packaging film waste by 11% with new splice procedures.
